egress.terms: Free and unmetered, images served from telegra.ph CDN paths with no auth and no hotlink limit. Same infrastructure Telegram uses.

record.tooling: Telegraph API (api.telegra.ph): createAccount, createPage, editPage, getPage, getPageList, getViews. Wrappers: github.com/TABmk/telegraph-wrapper, python-telegraph, many Telegram bots.
record.chaining: createAccount calls carry no stated limit (probe returned a fresh access_token instantly, no email), pages carry no stated limit, and each image is ~5 MB. Pages are editable indefinitely, so content is mutable in place.
record.limits_note: ~5 MB per image (JPEG/PNG/GIF/MP4). Uploads are multipart POST to https://telegra.ph/upload, NOT an api.telegra.ph method, and it is not part of the official API. The python-telegraph client's own wording for that is 'NOT PART OF OFFICIAL API, USE AT YOUR OWN RISK', which records that the endpoint is undocumented and unsupported.
record.reliability_note: Upload endpoint is undocumented and flaky from datacenter IPs: all four attempts (direct, via proxy, with browser UA/Origin/Referer) returned '"Unknown error"' or UNKNOWN_METHOD, while account creation and page API work perfectly. Assume upload needs a residential IP or a Telegram client.

evidence.proved: full method list (createAccount/createPage/editPage/getPage/getPageList/getViews); no upload method documented
probe: POST telegra.ph/upload multipart (PNG and JPEG, with and without UA+Origin+Referer) -> '"Unknown error"'; POST api.telegra.ph/upload -> {"ok":false,"error":"UNKNOWN_METHOD"}
